subtitle: Lesson 25 · Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT)

code:
ΔW ≈ B @ A
  A is (r x d_in)
  B is (d_out x r)
  r << min(d_in, d_out)

# forward pass:
h = x@W^T + (alpha/r) * (x@A^T @ B^T)
# W stays frozen -- only A, B get gradients
caption: r=16 on a 4096x4096 matrix: ~131K trainable params instead of ~17M.
